endpoint.name: Get campaign network settings
endpoint.summary: Get the networks a Sponsored Products campaign targets
endpoint.description: Returns the networks a Sponsored Products campaign targets. A network is a retailer serving surface, such as a country-specific site or a storefront of the same retailer. A campaign with no saved network settings returns an empty networks array.

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: Osmos generated unique identifier for the onboarded advertiser. Carried as a string per the published SDA v1 contract; the server validates it as a number (non-numeric -> 400).

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: Client-facing campaign-group ID. Resolved internally to the backing adgroup ID. Numeric value carried as a string per the published contract; server validates it as a number (non-numeric -> 400).

403.description: Authenticated but not authorized for this campaign.

constraints.emptyResponseNote: A campaign with no saved network settings returns an empty networks array.
